completed_milestones.summary: Environment audit, architecture and decision records, seven v1 contracts with examples and tests, olb CLI (validate, diagnose, check, state), roadmap and agent instructions.

World source tree with two working capabilities (text.stats, math.evaluate), a build-time capability invoker, olb world build and olb world verify, the digest algorithm, invocation protocol and data root default documented in CONTRACTS.md.

known_issues.summary: WSL is installed but not functional on the development machine, and no container engine is present.
known_issues.detail: Repairing WSL 2 needs administrator rights. Until then only the process isolation tier is available. See ADR-0006.

known_issues.summary: No local model is installed. Ollama is running with an empty model list.
known_issues.detail: S003b needs authorisation to pull one small text model (roughly 2-3 GB). S002 and S003a do not need a model.

known_issues.summary: FFmpeg and PyTorch are not installed.
The development machine is a laptop on a pre-release Windows build; sleep, updates and reboots will interrupt long runs.
known_issues.detail: Crash recovery (S006b) is mandatory. Power and update settings need review before multi-hour runs.

known_issues.summary: The Simulation and Window repositories are empty (no commits).
known_issues.detail: Each needs its own bootstrap as the first step of its first milestone.

known_issues.summary: World builds and the content digest have only been run on Windows.
known_issues.detail: The algorithm hashes stored bytes and the repository forces LF line endings, so the digest should be identical on Linux, but that has not been observed. Check it the first time a Linux environment is available.

known_issues.summary: No release has been published to the data root.
known_issues.detail: S003a needs 'olb world build worlds/minimal --publish', which creates open-lab-data in the home directory (or the directory named by OPEN_LAB_DATA). Confirm the location with the human before the first write there.

open_decisions.summary: Container mechanism for the container isolation tier (Podman in WSL 2 preferred).
open_decisions.detail: Decide once WSL is repaired and the options can be tested. ADR-0006.

open_decisions.summary: Which orchestrator model to use, and whether any model that fits in 4 GB of VRAM calls tools reliably enough.
open_decisions.detail: Decide by measurement in S003b. If local quality is inadequate, an explicitly enabled external provider is the fallback. ADR-0005.

open_decisions.summary: Window front-end stack: React with Vite and TypeScript, or server-rendered FastAPI with HTMX.
open_decisions.detail: Decide at the start of S004. ADR-0008.
